0022600229.text: The Mavericks, who are 7-4 and third in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, travel to face the 8-3 Timberwolves, the first place team in the Northwest, with Dallas on a three-game win streak and Minnesota on four. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and a game-time decision, while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost the season series 0-4, including a 124-94 defeat in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
